Question: How do I connect to UiTM campus Wi-Fi?
Answer: Select 'UiTM WiFi STUDENT' in your device Wi-Fi list. In the username box, enter your Student ID number, and in the password box, enter your iStudent Portal password. On Android devices, set CA Certificate to 'Don't validate' (or None) and tap Connect. On Apple iOS devices, tap 'Trust' when prompted by the certificate dialog.

Question: Why can't I connect to UiTM Wi-Fi on my laptop?
Answer: Saved Wi-Fi credentials often expire when portal passwords change. Open your laptop Wi-Fi settings, select 'Forget This Network' on 'UiTM WiFi STUDENT', and reconnect. If your operating system still rejects the connection, open your browser and visit wifi.uitm.edu.my/connect to download the automated setup profile for Windows or macOS.

Question: How do I submit an official IT complaint or network report?
Answer: Go to the ICT e-Aduan portal at units.uitm.edu.my and log in. Choose the category matching your issue (such as 'Rangkaian Tanpa Wayar' for Wi-Fi or 'Aplikasi' for portal errors), specify your exact campus location, and attach an error screenshot. Keep the generated Reference Number (Nombor Rujukan) to track updates under 'Semak Aduan'.

Question: How do I log in to the UiTM iStudent Portal?
Answer: Visit istudent.uitm.edu.my (or simsweb.uitm.edu.my) and log in with your Student ID and password. If you are a newly enrolled student logging in for the first time, you must read and accept the mandatory PDPA (Personal Data Protection Act) declaration pop-up before your dashboard and student records will load.

Question: What should I do if I forget my UiTM iStudent Portal password?
Answer: On the istudent.uitm.edu.my login page, click 'Forgot your password?'. Enter your registered Student ID and your IC number without any dashes. The system will dispatch a secure password reset link to your personal email address on record. New passwords must be at least 8 characters long with both uppercase and lowercase letters.

Question: Why is my UiTM student portal account locked and how do I fix it?
Answer: Accounts are automatically placed on a temporary security hold after 5 consecutive incorrect password entries. The system automatically releases this lockout after 15 to 30 minutes. If your account remains blocked after waiting, submit an unlock request to your campus ICT department at units.uitm.edu.my.

Question: Why are my enrolled subjects not appearing on UFUTURE?
Answer: UFUTURE is a learning platform that syncs data from UiTM registration records overnight, taking 1 to 3 days to display newly added courses. In UFUTURE, check under 'Menu > myCourse', verify that you are logged in using your student credentials rather than a personal Gmail, and complete any pending Entrance Survey forms.

Question: Why are my registered courses missing from my UiTM timetable schedule?
Answer: Class schedules are generated in ICRESS after registration is finalized in the ECR system (ecr.uitm.edu.my). Log in to i-Student Portal, open ICRESS, and ensure the drop-down menu is set to your active Session and Semester. If courses are confirmed in ECR but blank in ICRESS, consult your faculty course coordinator.

Question: How do I access UiTM internal systems from off-campus using VPN?
Answer: Log in to units.uitm.edu.my and submit a VPN Access Application. The request routes digitally to your Head of Department (Ketua PTj) for initial endorsement, then to Jabatan Digital for technical review. Once approved, setup instructions and login credentials are automatically emailed by the Network Unit.

Question: Who do I contact if I have issues with my Kad MySiswa?
Answer: For card replacement, RFID scan failures at campus gates, or missing debit functionalities, review the self-help documentation at mysiswa.uitm.edu.my/soalan-lazim or contact the Student Affairs Division (HEP) directly at 03-5544 3542 or 03-5544 3545.

Question: Where can I find information or troubleshooting for UiTM Single Sign-On (SSO)?
Answer: Visit faqsso.uitm.edu.my to troubleshoot session timeout errors, multi-app login conflicts, and unified credentials across integrated university web portals.

Question: What should I do if a student cannot log in to UiTM Microsoft 365?
Answer: Go to portal.office.com and ensure your username is entered as your full student email address: [StudentID]@isiswa.uitm.edu.my. If you changed your portal password recently, allow 30 minutes for cloud synchronization. For persistent 'account disabled' notices, log a ticket at units.uitm.edu.my.

Question: What should I do if a student cannot log in to their UiTM Google i-Siswa email?
Answer: Navigate to mail.google.com and enter your address using the format [StudentID]@isiswa.uitm.edu.my. Because i-Siswa Google accounts authenticate through UiTM credentials, any password change on the iStudent Portal updates your email login. Clear browser cookies or use an Incognito tab if authentication loops.

Question: How do I request UiTM web hosting services?
Answer: Staff and department webmasters must apply via units.uitm.edu.my by submitting the proposed sub-domain name along with a formal recommendation letter signed by the faculty dean or department head.

Question: How can UiTM staff apply for an official staff email account?
Answer: Newly appointed staff members can activate their official '@uitm.edu.my' email address by completing the digital onboarding guide at bit.ly/stafbaruuitm using their staff number and identity card.

Question: How do staff apply for new network node installations (LAN ports)?
Answer: Submit a work order through units.uitm.edu.my under 'Category: Rangkaian Berwayar' and select 'Others'. In the description, specify the room number, required wall port quantity, and justification.

Question: How do researchers apply for ICT hardware using research grant allocations?
Answer: Access units.uitm.edu.my, navigate to the 'Grant' navigation bar, and select 'Apply Grant' to upload your approved project paperwork and initiate the ICT hardware requisition workflow.

Question: Where can I access official UiTM ICT policies and circulars?
Answer: Official circulars regarding acceptable network use, software licensing compliance, and security governance can be downloaded from digital.uitm.edu.my under the 'Dasar dan Pekeliling ICT' tab.

Question: Why can't I submit my class attendance on UFUTURE?
Answer: Student class attendance on UFUTURE is strictly open only 15 minutes before until 15 minutes after the scheduled class session. Refresh your webpage during this 30-minute window, click 'Class Attendance > Schedule', and tap 'Register' to mark Present. UiTM regulations require at least 80% attendance to sit for final examinations.

Question: Can I submit multiple files for an assignment on UFUTURE?
Answer: UFUTURE allows multiple file submissions by compressing your documents into a single ZIP folder before uploading. Alternatively, you can upload your files to Google Drive and paste the shareable link in the submission box.

Question: What happens if my Wi-Fi disconnects while taking an online quiz on UFUTURE?
Answer: You can immediately resume answering your quiz or test once your network reconnects, as long as there is still remaining time left on the official test timer.

Question: Why won't course lecture files download properly on my phone from UFUTURE?
Answer: UFUTURE recommends using a desktop PC or laptop rather than a smartphone to download course materials that are not in PDF format. If a file prompts for a password, contact your course lecturer directly to obtain it.

Question: Why is my course progress percentage not updating on UFUTURE?
Answer: UFUTURE recalculates and synchronizes course activity progress in batches every 6 hours starting from 12:00 AM. If you recently completed activities or a MOOC module, allow up to 6 hours for your progress bar and certificate status to refresh.

Question: Who do I contact for technical issues specific to UFUTURE?
Answer: For technical errors inside UFUTURE, call the ICT iCEPS Helpdesk at 03-5544 8369 or 03-5544 8174, use the UFUTURE Chat Bot on the platform, or submit a report to units.uitm.edu.my.

Question: What is the Google Drive storage limit for UiTM students and staff?
Answer: Under UiTM's Google Workspace Education Plus policy, students receive 15 GB of cloud storage, while staff members are allocated 50 GB. This quota is shared across Gmail, Google Drive, and Google Photos. To check your current usage and clean up large files, visit drive.google.com/settings/storage.

Question: What should I do if Gmail says Couldn't find your Google Account?
Answer: This error indicates your official university Google account has not yet been activated in the system. Log in to units.uitm.edu.my using a personal email, select 'Category: OPERASI - EMEL GOOGLE', choose 'Sub Category: NEW ACCOUNT', and provide a valid alternative email so IT staff can dispatch your login credentials.

Question: Where can new UiTM students find their initial Google email password?
Answer: Your official username is your Student Number followed by @student.uitm.edu.my (or @isiswa.uitm.edu.my). Your initial temporary password is sent directly to the alternative personal email address you registered on the Student Portal during admission.

Question: Where can I access all UiTM staff and student email logins in one place?
Answer: Visit the UiTM Email One Stop Center at mail.uitm.edu.my. This central directory provides separate direct login buttons and user manuals for Gmail Staff, Gmail Student, and Microsoft 365.

Question: How do I enable 2-Step Verification on my UiTM Google account?
Answer: Sign in to your UiTM Google account, open your Google Account Settings (myaccount.google.com), click 'Security' on the left menu, select '2-Step Verification' under 'How you sign in to Google', and follow the prompts to register your mobile phone or authenticator app.

Question: How do I sync UiTM Google Drive directly to my computer without using a browser?
Answer: You can install Google Drive for Desktop (formerly Drive File Stream) on your Windows or Mac computer. Download the installer from the Google Drive Help Center, sign in with your UiTM student or staff email, and access your cloud files directly through Windows File Explorer or macOS Finder.

Question: How do I find and download past year exam papers online at UiTM?
Answer: Go to the PTAR PERMATA portal at permata.uitm.edu.my, navigate to 'Information Resources' and click 'Exam Paper' (EQPS). Log in with your Student ID and portal password, then search using your course code or course name. Please note that this portal provides past examination question papers only; answer marking schemes are not provided.

Question: How do I access subscribed research databases like IEEE and ScienceDirect from home?
Answer: Visit the PTAR Library portal at library.uitm.edu.my or permata.uitm.edu.my and select 'Online Databases' or 'EZProxy'. Log in using your UiTM Student ID and iStudent Portal password to route your connection through university licensing, allowing you to download peer-reviewed journals and articles for free.

Question: Where can UiTM students download EndNote citation software for free?
Answer: UiTM subscribes to EndNote for students and staff. You can download the licensed installer for Windows or Mac from the PTAR repository at iknow.library.uitm.edu.my under research software. If the installer archive prompts for an extraction password, contact PTAR via 'Chat with Librarian' to request the active license key.

Question: How do I access and manage my UiTM Digital Student ID?
Answer: Go to kad.uitm.edu.my and sign in via UiTM WebSSO using your Student ID and password. Click the 'Digital ID' icon on the main menu to view your official virtual student identification card, which serves as a recognized digital companion to your physical card.

Question: What are the photo upload requirements on the UiTM Card Management System (UCMS)?
Answer: Photos uploaded at kad.uitm.edu.my must feature a plain royal blue background, formal attire (collared shirt or blazer; dark-coloured tudung for Muslim female students), measure 3.5cm x 4.0cm, be in JPG or PNG format, and not exceed 200 KB in file size.

Question: How do visiting students and researchers connect to eduroam Wi-Fi at UiTM?
Answer: Visitors whose home institutions participate in the eduroam federation can select the 'eduroam' wireless SSID on any UiTM campus. Log in using your complete home institution email address and university password without needing a temporary guest account.

Question: What should I do if web pages or YouTube load slowly or are blocked on campus?
Answer: If you encounter severe bandwidth throttling or connection timeouts on the university network, submit an online ticket at units.uitm.edu.my under Network Services or contact the central IT Helpdesk at 03-5544 2203 with your campus, building, and IP address.

Question: How long is the password reset link valid for UiTM portal accounts?
Answer: The password recovery verification link dispatched to your registered personal email address is valid for 24 hours. If the link is not activated and a new password created within 24 hours, you must initiate a fresh recovery request.

Question: What should a lecturer do if SIMS shows The screen is closed when uploading exam marks?
Answer: This error occurs when an incompatible mark entry template is used. Ensure you download RES template #5 (specifically designated for internal UiTM examiners) rather than template #3, and open the file using Microsoft Excel 2013 or newer on a Windows operating system.

Question: What should staff do if SIMS shows Account Disabled or Access Expired?
Answer: If you encounter an 'Account Disabled' or 'Access Expired' notification when logging in to SIMS Akademik or SIMS eHEP, contact your PTJ academic liaison officer or call the technical helpdesk at 03-5544 2203 to verify your active term role assignment.

Question: Which academic software packages require an active connection to the UiTM campus network?
Answer: IBM SPSS & AMOS, MATLAB, and ArcGIS utilize institutional concurrent network licenses and must be executed while connected directly to the UiTM campus Wi-Fi or wired lab network to pass server license validation.

Question: How do UiTM staff apply for an official Cisco Webex account?
Answer: Sign in to the university booking system at bsu.uitm.edu.my using your i-Staf credentials. Navigate to 'Software' > 'New Software Booking', select 'Pej. Pemb. Infrastruktur & Infostruktur', choose 'Category: WEBX - CISCO WEBEX', enter your justification, and submit the booking.

Question: How can UiTM students access free academic developer software from Microsoft Azure?
Answer: UiTM students can access professional developer tools through Azure Dev Tools for Teaching. Visit signup.azure.com/studentverification?offerType=3, authenticate using your official UiTM student email address, and complete multi-factor verification via the Microsoft Authenticator app.

Question: Why is my webpage blocked by Web Application Firewall (WAF) when browsing UFUTURE?
Answer: If your network connection triggers an automated Web Application Firewall block on UFUTURE, take a screenshot of the incident screen showing the IP and Event ID, then log in to units.uitm.edu.my and log a ticket under 'Category: SECURITY - WEB APPLICATION FIREWALL (WAF)'.

Question: Can I change my profile picture directly inside UFUTURE?
Answer: No, students cannot update profile pictures from within the UFUTURE interface. You must upload and verify your formal photo on the UiTM Card Management System at kad.uitm.edu.my, and the verified image will synchronize automatically with your UFUTURE profile.

Question: What should I do if my computer or laptop is overheating?
Answer: Turn off the device immediately to allow it to cool down, verify that the cooling fan is operating properly, avoid placing laptops on soft surfaces or floors while working, and consider using an additional cooling pad

Question: Why do external USB devices like printers or scanners fail to work when connected via a USB hub?
Answer: Unpowered USB hubs, monitors, or intermediate adapters often do not provide sufficient electrical power to run demanding peripherals; connect the USB cable directly into one of the computer's built-in USB ports

Question: What should I check if my laptop cannot find or connect to wireless networks?
Answer: Verify that your laptop has a wireless network adapter installed, that the driver is up to date, and that the adapter is enabled, then click the network icon in the notification area, select your Wi-Fi SSID, and enter the network security key
